problem: 3D snaky-corridor moving sofa (Problem 6.64 of arXiv:2511.02864), upper bound via the event-forced tube family of arXiv:2610.14050 (Prop. 6.1)
grid_meaning: nkx, nkz, nt, nx: root boxes = kx-cells x kz-cells x t-cells x X1-cells x X2-cells
codes_format: one byte per node in depth-first preorder over the root boxes (root index order: kx slowest, then kz, t, X1, X2 fastest; child order: lower half first); 0 = leaf, d+1 = split at the midpoint of dimension d (0 kx, 1 kz, 2 t, 3 X1, 4 X2)
